purpose: Add a characteristic-2 algebraic closure that strictly sees global parity contradictions invisible to width-3 resolution and singleton/pair failed-literal probing. Encode every clause by its Boolean unsatisfied-indicator polynomial and compute the full polynomial-calculus/Macaulay closure inside the squarefree degree-at-most-three quotient space. This is polynomial because that space has O(n^3) monomials.

boolean_polynomial_encoding.quotient: Work modulo x_i^2=x_i, so every polynomial is represented by squarefree monomials.
boolean_polynomial_encoding.literal_false_factor: For positive literal x_i use 1+x_i; for negative literal NOT x_i use x_i.
boolean_polynomial_encoding.clause_axiom: For clause C=(l_1 OR ... OR l_t), t<=3, use p_C=product_j false(l_j)=0. On every Boolean assignment p_C=1 exactly when C is falsified.
boolean_polynomial_encoding.degree3_space: V_3=span over GF(2) of all squarefree monomials of degree at most three. dim(V_3)=sum_{j=0}^3 binom(n,j)=O(n^3).

closure_algorithm.initial_rows: Insert all clause polynomials p_C into V_3.
closure_algorithm.multiplication_rule: Whenever q is in the current row space and x_i*q, multilinearized modulo x_i^2=x_i, still has degree at most three, insert x_i*q.
closure_algorithm.linear_rule: Maintain the GF(2) row span by Gaussian elimination and iterate multiplication until the span stabilizes.
closure_algorithm.unsat_certificate: If the constant polynomial 1 enters the span, then the input CNF is UNSAT. Store row-combination parents to obtain a polynomial-size degree<=3 algebraic refutation certificate.
closure_algorithm.runtime: There are O(n^3) basis monomials and at most that many independent rows. Naive repeated multiplication by n variables and Gaussian elimination is polynomial in n and input size; no assignment enumeration is used.

strict_gain_control.instance: Odd-charge Tseitin contradiction on the cubic graph K4: six edge variables and four degree-3 parity constraints, each parity constraint encoded by four 3-CNF clauses, for 16 ternary clauses total.
strict_gain_control.parents_silence: The v4.0 exact checker verifies that complete width<=3 resolution and every consistent singleton/pair unit-propagation probe add nothing on this UNSAT instance.
strict_gain_control.local_parity_extraction: For one degree-3 parity equation x+y+z=b, summing its four forbidden-assignment clause polynomials in GF(2) gives exactly x+y+z+b=0.
strict_gain_control.global_refutation: Summing the four extracted K4 vertex equations cancels every edge variable twice. For odd total charge the result is 1=0, so the degree-3 Macaulay span contains the constant 1 and refutes the instance.
strict_gain_control.meaning: The degree-3 GF2 closure is a strict polynomial preprocessing gain over the frozen width3/pair-closed kernel.

soundness.theorem: Every generated row belongs to the Boolean ideal consequence space of the clause axioms under degree<=3 multiplication. Any Boolean model annihilates every initial clause polynomial and therefore every generated linear/multiplicative consequence. Hence derivation of 1 is a sound UNSAT certificate.
soundness.sat_side: Failure to derive 1 is INCONCLUSIVE. A SAT verdict is never inferred from algebraic silence.

fixed_degree_barrier.statement: Degree three is not a universal refutation bound. More generally, fixed-degree polynomial-calculus/Macaulay closure cannot decide arbitrary 3-CNF in polynomial time by completeness of that bounded degree alone.
evidence: Buss-Grigoriev-Impagliazzo-Pitassi prove near-optimal linear polynomial-calculus degree lower bounds for Tseitin/counting principles over mismatched characteristics.
Modern generalized PC degree lower-bound frameworks also yield growing degree requirements for random k-CNF and expanding clause-variable incidence families over arbitrary fields.
fixed_degree_barrier.cross_characteristic_firewall: Characteristic 2 is exactly the favorable field for ordinary mod-2 Tseitin, so success on the K4 control is expected and useful, not evidence of universal tractability. Other hard families force the required degree to grow.

positive: Pair-closed kernels can be strengthened by all degree<=3 GF2 algebraic consequences in deterministic polynomial time.
Native or syntactically recoverable XOR/Tseitin contradictions are collapsed by Gaussian row-space reasoning even when resolution-style local reasoning is silent.
killed: Claim that width3 resolution plus pair probing already captures all polynomially accessible global information.
Claim that success of degree-3 GF2 closure on Tseitin implies arbitrary 3-SAT is solved.
not_killed: Hybrid proof systems combining parity with genuinely non-affine/global constraints.
A source-specific contraction whose state is not bounded-degree monomial space.

next_target.name: E8_PARITY_CLOSED_NONAFFINE_CORE_V4_2
next_target.directive: Run terminal projection, width3 resolution, pair probing, and GF2 degree3 closure first. Attack only kernels surviving all four. Extract every low-degree affine consequence but do not confuse affine closure with the OR3 hard core. Seek a polynomial-size invariant that couples parity subspaces with the remaining genuinely non-affine ternary atoms without fixed-degree monomial expansion, or produce an exact barrier for that hybrid route.

sources: S. Buss, D. Grigoriev, R. Impagliazzo, T. Pitassi, Linear Gaps between Degrees for the Polynomial Calculus Modulo Distinct Primes, JCSS 62(2), 2001.
A Generalized Method for Proving Polynomial Calculus Degree Lower Bounds, Journal of the ACM, 2024.
